title: NMC² data center night shift
summary: One operator's rounds through a colo hall: cold aisle, rack R12, its PDU, cooling, cable work on the core switch, a PSU fault on PDU-A, a handwritten ticket note, and the UPS room. Drives the alert beat (PDU-A PSU2 OK → FAULT) and the shift handoff.
style: Unedited first-person snapshot from a head-mounted wearable camera at eye level, deep focus with everything sharp, no bokeh, inside an enterprise colocation data center, slightly off-level framing, cool white LED lighting, light sensor noise, mild wide-angle lens distortion, realistic textures, no people or faces in frame.

shots.prompt: Looking down a cold aisle between two rows of black server racks with perforated floor tiles; a large blue sign hanging from the ceiling reads "COLD AISLE 3" in bold white letters.
Front of a black server rack with glass door, rows of 1U servers with green status LEDs; a large white label at the top of the rack door reads "R12" in black block letters.

Close-up of a vertical rack power distribution unit mounted inside rack R12; a white sticker label reads "PDU-A" in black block letters; its small backlit LCD shows "10.9 kW" and below it "PSU2 OK" with a green status light.
Control panel of a large precision cooling unit at the end of the row; a metal plate reads "CRAC-2"; the LCD shows "SUPPLY 18.2C" and "RETURN 27.5C".
A gloved hand holding a yellow single-mode fiber patch cable plugged into a dense patch panel; a white printed cable tag on the cable reads "P24" in large black text.
Front of a network core switch in a rack with many blinking amber and green port LEDs and neatly dressed blue cables; a large white label on the chassis reads "SW-CORE-1".

Close-up of a vertical rack power distribution unit mounted inside rack R12; a white sticker label reads "PDU-A" in black block letters; its small backlit LCD shows "11.8 kW" and below it "PSU2 FAULT" with a red status light.
A yellow sticky note taped to a server rack door, handwritten in black marker: "INC-4821 PSU2 swap pending".
Front touchscreen panel of a large floor-standing UPS cabinet in an electrical room; a nameplate reads "UPS-1"; the screen shows "ONLINE" in green and "LOAD 42%".
